verdict.rationale: LegalOS is an AI-assisted immigration-filing SaaS rather than a coding agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions an MCP server, an agent connection, or any programmatic interface. Probes found no llms.txt and no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
